scenes.narration: A puppy is hiding in one of these boxes! Which one is it?
Is it the RED box, the BLUE box, or the GREEN box?
Pick your box right now! Three... two... one!
The RED box — let's open it! Oh no, it's just a rubber duck!
The BLUE box — maybe this one? Nope! It's a smelly old sock!
The GREEN box — the puppy HAS to be in here! Open it up... YES! There it is!
Did you pick GREEN? Nice job! Come back tomorrow for Level 2!
